info.name: FritzBox Talk Bridge
info.summary: Enable/disable the FritzBox phone line connection for Talk calls.
info.description: Admin settings for the FritzBox Talk Bridge daemon: shows live registration status and turns the phone gateway connection on or off. Calls themselves use Talk's own native call UI - incoming calls appear as regular participants, outgoing calls use "call a phone number".
info.author: FritzBox Talk Bridge
